title: System logs
whyItMatters: System logs record logins with usernames and IP addresses, commands run as root, USB devices plugged in and services started. They build a timeline of how the machine was used.
source: FHS 3.0, /var/log: variable log data for the system lives in /var/log: https://refspecs.linuxfoundation.org/FHS_3.0/fhs/ch05s15.html
notes: auth.log, syslog and the journal directory hold the useful history, including rotated and compressed copies. Many files are root-only, so the engine records them as permission skips rather than reading them.
